subject.title: [Feature]: Agents page selector should be a themed HTML dropdown showing agent avatars

question: Should the Agents page get the focused avatar-aware custom dropdown now, or should this be folded into the broader visible-list/sidebar direction tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57067?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested dropdown, but the protected label and overlapping broader navigation request make the permanent UI direction a maintainer choice rather than an autonomous cleanup decision.

options.title: Implement focused dropdown
options.body: Build the custom accessible agent selector now while keeping the broader visible-list request open for separate layout work.

options.title: Fold into visible-list redesign
options.body: Keep this open as a design input for the broader Agents navigation change instead of adding a richer dropdown first.

options.title: Keep native select
options.body: Treat the compact native selector as intentional and close or retitle the request after documenting that decision.

recommendation.title: Implement focused dropdown
recommendation.body: Build the custom accessible agent selector now while keeping the broader visible-list request open for separate layout work.

likelyOwner.reason: The protected issue was opened by steipete and the remaining choice is primarily Control UI product/design direction.
